contract.move_guard: Existing shared Backtester, true for both Madrid modes; no second manager
contract.atr_mode: Raw TP M1±distance_atr×ATR14, absolute_signal_target true; offset ATR already in price stop columns. Operability validated before lot. Explicit profit overrides may replace invalid default TP.
contract.points_mode: Target columns are M1 reference, not TP. Candidates lack a symbol conversion until shared Backtester validates abs(signal close−M1)<=N×SymbolSpec.point and normalizes default TP M1±N×point before lot.
contract.overrides: Explicit fill target_points / fill-and-initial-risk target_r have higher priority; reference-distance entry filter remains active. Fixed stop replaces only initial stop; shared median guard remains.
contract.adapter_change: Owner authorized sixth runtime: preserve target/reference columns under profit override only if new reference field is non-None; legacy/S10/VWAP clearing unchanged.
contract.seeds: EMA0=C0; EMA alpha2/(period+1). ATR0=TR0=H0−L0; ATR RMA alpha1/14; no SMA seed.
contract.prefix: HLC positive finite non-sentinel and recursive finite values; invalid prefix blocks remainder. Flat zero ATR may recover. Fixed frame differs from native rolling1500.
contract.cycle_variant: Previous equality permits trigger; no persistent FC/FV or restart deduplication. Fixed TP, not dynamic TP from study.
